notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'.
goFirst false: the guide gives no seat advice; the general default is to go second (strategy-concepts §10 [S17]).

cardValue: ongoing effects named in the guide's Defining cards (Gorgon Sisters' DON!! spread, Ran's DON!! gift, Borsalino's Blocker and Life refill, the 9-cost Hancock's Life swing). The sizes are inferences.
weights.hand 1.1: 'turns the opponent's attacks into card draw' [SH-HAN] (the leader draws when a Character is played on their turn); inference.
counterAggression 0.9: 'its Life Triggers play Kuja Pirates Characters for free' [SH-HAN], so a hit gives the deck a body and a draw; inference: it counters slightly less readily than the default.
faceBias 1.0/1.0/1.1: the plan closes with the 9-cost Hancock once they are at 3 or less Life [SH-HAN]; inference: slightly more weight on the opponent's Life late.
Every number here is an inference (review M5a-09): the guide gives the direction, not the value.
Seed 1 is the giveDon bias on the Leader: 'leave one DON!! on Hancock before passing' [SH-HAN] switches on her K.O. effect for their turn.
Seed 2 (activate every Life Trigger that plays a Character) has no bias: the planted test and the self-play check whether search alone does it.
Seed 3 is playOnlyIf with oppLifeAtMost 3: Shakuyaku's draw 2 / trash 2 needs them at 3 or less Life [CARD][SH-HAN].
Seed 4 is two biases on Hiyori's On Play: accept it while a Trigger card is in hand (triggerInHand), and pickWithTrigger for the card [SH-HAN]. Neither is cited: both read a hidden card.

Mulligan: the guide's sourced baseline is 'mulligan for Pudding or Zoro; a hand with neither is the one to send back' [SH-HAN]; the Trigger Character piece is the guide's keepable-hand inference. The seat allowance is 0: the sourced rule does not name one.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one.

biases.cite: Its guide: leave one DON!! on Hancock before passing, so a K.O. of a 5000-power Kuja on their turn pulls a Life card.

assertions.text: Ends each turn from T2 with at least 1 DON!! given to the Leader.
Activates every Life Trigger that plays a Character when it is revealed on the opponent's turn.
Plays Shakuyaku from hand only when the opponent has 3 or less Life.
Uses Kouzuki Hiyori to put a Trigger card on top of its Life whenever a Trigger card is in hand.
